intro: Everything is baked in small batches with unbleached flour, raw sugar, grass-fed butter and dye-free ingredients. The offerings change with the seasons, so what you see here is a taste of what's coming out of the oven.
sample_notice: Sample menu: final flavors and pricing are coming soon. Message me and I'll tell you what's baking this week.

categories.name: Cakes
categories.blurb: Custom celebration cakes and bakery-case slices, finished with real buttercream and whipped cream.
categories.image_alt: Custom layered celebration cake with buttercream shell border and hand-piped lettering, made by Mountain Whisk in Shirley, Arkansas

items.name: Custom Celebration Cake
items.description: Layer cakes designed around your theme. Birthdays, showers, anniversaries and small weddings.

items.name: Sheet-Cake Slices
items.description: Vanilla with whipped cream, blueberry cream, and cinnamon-sugar crumb. Flavors rotate with the season.

items.name: Mini Carrot Cake with Caramel
items.description: A single-serve carrot cake with cream cheese frosting and a caramel finish.

categories.name: Cinnamon Rolls
categories.blurb: Soft, slow-risen rolls with a generous swirl. Full-size for breakfast, minis for sharing.
categories.image_alt: Mini cinnamon rolls with maple icing in paper cups on a rustic wooden board

items.name: Classic Cinnamon Roll
items.description: Buttery dough, cinnamon-sugar swirl and a simple cream icing.

items.name: Maple Pecan Cinnamon Roll
items.description: Topped with maple icing and candied pecans.

items.name: Mini Cinnamon Roll Box
items.description: Mix-and-match minis. A crowd-pleaser for brunches, showers and rental welcome baskets.

categories.name: Scones
categories.blurb: Tender, crumbly and never dry, finished with fruit glazes tinted by real fruit.
categories.image_alt: Fresh-baked cherry chocolate scones with pink fruit glaze on a wooden board in front of pine trees

items.name: Blueberry Lemon Scone
items.description: Bright citrus, plump blueberries and a crisp crumb topping.

items.name: Cherry Chocolate Scone
items.description: Dark chocolate and tart cherries with a fruit glaze.

items.name: Peach Scone
items.description: Ripe peaches folded into a buttery scone. Available while the fruit is in season.

items.name: Apple Fritter Scone
items.description: Cinnamon-spiced apples and a sweet glaze. A fall staple.

categories.name: Cookies & Sweet Treats
categories.blurb: Big, soft cookies and bakery-case favorites, sold singly or in mix-and-match boxes.
categories.image_alt: Box of assorted Mountain Whisk bakes including scones, fruit hand pies, a frosted cookie and cinnamon rolls

items.name: Chocolate Chip Cookie
items.description: Crisp edges, soft center, real chocolate.

items.name: Espresso Chocolate Cookie
items.description: Deep chocolate with a coffee kick.

items.name: Fruit Hand Pies
items.description: Flaky pastry, fruit filling and a light glaze. Flavors change with the season.

categories.name: Breads
categories.blurb: Loaves and rolls made the traditional way, with nothing you can't pronounce.

items.name: Sourdough Loaf
items.description: Long-fermented, crackly crust and a tender, tangy crumb.

items.name: Cinnamon Swirl Loaf
items.description: Soft sandwich-style loaf with a ribbon of cinnamon sugar.

items.name: Soft Dinner Rolls
items.description: Pillowy, buttery rolls by the half-dozen or dozen.

items.name: Rosemary Focaccia
items.description: Olive oil, flaky salt and fresh rosemary.
